text:
alex: Quick kickoff — NovaSI joint perf/W + kernel-tune sweep. Need to confirm lab window, telemetry schema, and kernel patch delivery. Who can support next week? cc @maria @troy
maria: I can do mid-week. Prefer a short smoke then wider runs.
troy: Partner asked for a focused smoke: seq lengths 128/512, batch 1/4/8, perf/W + throughput per node. Expand after we baseline.
jia: To validate kernel patches I need their kernel branch and a clear bisect entrypoint. Also require node_exporter and nvlink counters if possible.
kate: I'll ask NovaSI for branch + sftp creds. @nova_pm can you confirm telemetry endpoints and access method?
nova_pm: We can provide node_exporter, nvlink, and a secure SFTP for kernel trees. Legal wants an NDA addendum for vendor counters — sent to your legal.
bench-bot: Telemetry schema proposal:
```
cpu_power_w
gpu_power_w
board_power_w
node_temp_c
ambient_temp_c
token_throughput
latency_p50
latency_p95
kv_cache_hit_rate
```
sam: Also capture power cap, fan profile, BIOS revision, and driver version in run metadata. Small powercap differences change perf/W a lot.
maria: Suggest pass/fail: throughput regression <= 10% vs baseline, perf/W drop <= 5% post-tune. Any comments?
troy: Add p99 tail latency tracking and explicit warm vs cold KV cache tags.
alex: Owners: I'll create the runbook + bench scripts. Kate handles partner comms + legal. Jia owns kernel validation harness. Maria creates analysis dashboard and thresholds. Sam handles node reservations and run gating.
kate: Pinged NovaSI PM for branch and creds, they said EOD.
jia: I'll port our git-bisect + perfstat harness into ci-runner. Example run: `./ci/run_bench.sh --config configs/novasi-smoke.json --collect perfstat`
maria: Pre-run checklist items: env snapshot, powercap, BIOS, kernel commit, NV driver ver, pinned model ver, dataset shard id. Put in runbook.
alex: Create minimal Grafana dashboard template for perf/W and throughput. Bench-bot tags suggestion: `partner=novasi`, `run_id=<uuid>`, `kernel_commit=<sha>`, `power_cap_w=<n>`
sam: Proposed lab window Wed 09:00 - Fri 18:00 PT next week. Reserving 2 test nodes + 1 bench node. Will script reboots between runs to reduce thermal drift.
kate: Legal confirmed NDA addendum queued. NovaSI will provide infra creds by EOD.
maria: I'll assemble the pass/fail checklist and upload to runbook.
alex: Pre-run sync: Monday 30m with NovaSI to confirm telemetry fields and cadence. I'll send calendar invite. Will post runbook link here when live. :thumbsup:
